events.speaker: customer
events.text: The refrigerator is in the garage, and water is leaking right now.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: My partner says it is still leaking, but I think the water may be from yesterday; I cannot tell whether there is an active leak. Wednesday morning might work, though I am not sure yet.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I checked the pipe, and water is coming from it right now. Thursday afternoon works better for me than Wednesday morning; please give me a quote before any work.
